text:
Mei Chen: Quick smoke from hopper-2 qprofile run across eu/us/apac. TL;DR: FP8 gives ~1.9x token/sec on H100 vs FP16 with ~<0.5% quality delta on our answer-eval set; INT8 on A100 is ~1.6x but shows ~1.5-2.5% quality regression on dialog prompts.

Samir Patel: Nice. Which model variant and sequence length?

Mei Chen: hopper-2-3B (decoder-only), seq=1024 warmup 20, eval set = 2k customer-like prompts (mix instruction/chat). bs=4 for latency tests, bs=16 for throughput.

Nora Alvarez: Can you paste the exact numbers? latencies and p95?

Mei Chen: H100 eu-west-1:
- FP16:  token/sec=120, p95=86ms
- BF16:  token/sec=118, p95=88ms
- FP8 (e5m3): token/sec=230, p95=95ms, quality delta vs FP16 = -0.4% (answer-eval)
- INT8 (dynamic-Q): token/sec=210, p95=120ms, quality delta = -1.8%

A100 us-west-2:
- FP16: token/sec=100, p95=95ms
- INT8: token/sec=160, p95=140ms, quality delta = -2.3%

L4 ap-southeast-1 (smaller): FP16 70 tps, FP8 unsupported on current kernel

Samir Patel: Interesting that FP8 p95 is only slightly higher on H100. Which kernel? custom fused-attn?

Mei Chen: Using runtime kernel: 'attn_v2_fused' + e5m3 FP8 path. Kernel flag: --kernel attn_v2_fused --quant-profile e5m3

Carlos Ruiz: Any examples of hallucination uptick or length-dependent regressions?

Mei Chen: Short answer: minor for FP8 on freeform summarization (rare long-answer hallucination up by ~0.6%). INT8 shows more variance on multi-turn QA.

benchbot: CSV uploaded https://s3.redwood-internal/bench/hopper2_qprofiles_1945678901.csv :thumbsup:

Nora Alvarez: Can you drop the run command? I want to reproduce.

Mei Chen:
```
./run_bench --model hopper-2-3b --quant e5m3 --gpu h100 --region eu-west-1 --seq 1024 --bs 4 --warmup 20 --evalset s3://redwood-evalsets/answer-eval-2k.jsonl
```

Samir Patel: Perf notes: FP8 needs KV cache alignment tweak, set ENV KVCACHE_ALIGN=128 to avoid jitter.

Mei Chen: noted. Also flagged a kernel fallback on some A100 drivers; infra-bot raised ticket #INF-472.

infra-bot: Ticket INF-472 created for A100 driver/kernel mismatch.

Carlos Ruiz: Plan: run formal 10-run CI for top candidates (FP16, FP8 H100; INT8 A100) and then schedule canary on Dedicated EU pool.

Mei Chen: I'll start CI tomorrow and post full charts. For now, don't enable INT8 in prod for dialog-heavy routes.

Nora Alvarez: thanks — please add a short eval to Redwood Console for the critical prompt set.

Mei Chen: will do. :white_check_mark:
